Starting with

[MATH: -x^2 \leq f(x) \leq x^2,]

[MATH: lim_(x → 0)(− x^{2}) ≤|lim_(x → 0)f(x) ≤ lim_(x → 0)(x^{2}); 0 ≤|lim_(x → 0)f(x) ≤ 0.]
